headline: Kuura Strand Ignites While Marban Hollow and Northern Fronts Churn
war_summary: Kuura Strand has suddenly burst into action, with Colonial forces seizing Martti amidst a sharp surge in reinforcements and accelerating casualties over the past two hours. Simultaneously, Marban Hollow witnessed renewed volatility, recording five rapid base transitions across Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall. Sustained frontline friction continues in Weathered Expanse, where three fresh base conversions and more than thirteen hundred casualties were logged in the latest two-hour span around Spirit Watch and Crow's Nest. In Olavi's Wake and The Gutter, strategic bases continue to swap hands across Iltaku, Kulkue, and Kuoppa, even as casualty rates moderate from their previous peaks. Pari Peak registered further clashes around Pariah, while Stlican Shelf slowed following earlier battles over Breaker Town. Meanwhile, grinding attritional engagements persist without direct territorial exchange in Callahan's Passage, Farranac Coast, and Stonecradle.
